briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent race amid rising security gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has intensified with new model releases from OpenAI and xAI driving capability gains while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Funding remains robust but compute bottlenecks persist. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical operational risks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning chains; xAI launched Grok-4 showing strong multi-agent performance. DeepSeek-V3.5 closed the gap on coding benchmarks while Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus entered limited testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early pilots in automotive and IoT showing 94% attack mitigation.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 1.2M units shipped; Google TPU v6 clusters expanded in Iowa. Microsoft announced $4B data center expansion in Texas focused on sovereign AI workloads.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace safety hardening by 2027?
